run_rst2htmlrefdoc_cli: run the rst2htmlrefdoc script to convert a reStructuredText file into framed HTML reference documentation
register_copyright_directive: register the copyright directive using htmlrefdoc LicenseAndCopyright for reStructuredText documents
publish_cmdline_html4_refdoc: use publish_cmdline with the html4_refdoc writer to generate framed HTML from RST sources
set_locale_for_rst_processing: set the system locale before processing reStructuredText documents for proper character encoding
convert_rst_to_framed_html: convert standalone reStructuredText sources into framed XHTML documents using the docutils command-line interface
